subject: Matemática
description_pt: Resolver e elaborar problemas de adição e subtração com os significados de juntar, acrescentar, separar, retirar, comparar e completar quantidades, utilizando diferentes estratégias de cálculo exato ou aproximado, incluindo cálculo mental.

components.description_pt: Resolver problemas de adição e subtração envolvendo combinar, acrescentar ou separar quantidades
components.description_en: Solve addition and subtraction problems involving combining, adding to, or separating quantities
components.cc_component_description: Use addition and subtraction within 100 to solve two-step word problems involving situations of adding to, taking from, putting together, taking apart, and comparing, with unknowns in all positions

components.description_pt: Compor um problema de adição ou subtração que represente uma situação real
components.description_en: Compose an addition or subtraction problem that represents a given real-world situation
components.cc_component_description: Represent a real-world addition or subtraction situation using an equation or diagram

components.description_pt: Aplicar estratégias de cálculo mental para calcular somas e diferenças exatas ou aproximadas
components.description_en: Apply mental computation strategies to calculate exact or approximate sums and differences
components.cc_component_description: Assess the reasonableness of answers using mental computation and estimation strategies

cc_matches.description: Solve multi-step real-life and mathematical problems posed with positive and negative rational numbers in any form (whole numbers, fractions, and decimals), using tools strategically. Apply properties of operations to calculate with numbers in any form; convert between forms as appropriate; and assess the reasonableness of answers using mental computation and estimation strategies. *For example: If a woman making $25 an hour gets a 10% raise, she will make an additional $\frac{1}{10}$ of her salary an hour, or $2.50, for a new salary of $27.50. If you want to place a towel bar $9\frac{3}{4}$ inches long in the center of a door that is $27\frac{1}{2}$ inches wide, you will need to place the bar about 9 inches from each edge; this estimate can be used as a check on the exact computation.*

Use addition and subtraction within 100 to solve one- and two-step word problems involving situations of adding to, taking from, putting together, taking apart, and comparing, with unknowns in all positions, e.g., by using drawings and equations with a symbol for the unknown number to represent the problem.
